prompt-schedule.budget.notice: The daily limit of self-started turns was reached ({n, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} / 24 hours): timers and background reports do not wake it for now and resume by themselves once the turns in the last 24 hours drop; the limit can be changed in the resident Agent's settings
prompt-schedule.budget.title: {title}: daily limit of self-started turns reached
prompt-schedule.carry.callbacksLater: (no room this time for the callbacks of {ids}; they are delivered separately later)
prompt-schedule.carry.reportsLater: (no room this time for what {ids} reported; it is delivered separately later)
prompt-schedule.cron.fields: a cron expression needs 5 fields: minute hour day month weekday (for example */30 * * * *)
prompt-schedule.cronText.hours: {n, plural, one {Every hour} other {Every # hours}} (at minute {minute})
prompt-schedule.ended.budget: When it was due, the daily limit of self-started turns was reached; no wake-up
prompt-schedule.ended.expired: Reached its set end time (set a new cron to continue)
prompt-schedule.ended.full: When it was due, the message queue was full; no wake-up
prompt-schedule.ended.gone: The session is archived or paused
prompt-schedule.ended.lost: The node's Runner restarted and this background task ended with it (not re-run automatically)
prompt-schedule.ended.pausedExpired: Reached its set end time while paused
prompt-schedule.ended.pausedMissed: Its time passed while paused; not run late
prompt-schedule.error.background: At most {n, plural, one {# background command / monitor} other {# background commands / monitors}} at a time: wait for them to end, or cancel them
prompt-schedule.error.cronGap: Two firings must be at least 1 minute apart
prompt-schedule.error.cronNoDelay: For a recurring timer, change its cron
prompt-schedule.error.node: {n, plural, one {# background command / monitor is} other {# background commands / monitors are}} already running on this node (at most {max} per node): start this once some have ended — you can set a wakeup and try again later
prompt-schedule.error.notFound: No such timer or background task
prompt-schedule.error.notOwner: Only the session's owner can set or cancel timers
prompt-schedule.error.onlyWaiting: Only a timer that is still waiting can be changed (background commands cannot)
prompt-schedule.error.ownerBackground: Background commands can only be started by the AI in its workspace
prompt-schedule.error.pattern: pattern is not a valid regular expression
prompt-schedule.error.residentHeld: The resident Agent is paused or archived: resume it first
prompt-schedule.error.sidecar: An ask-only side branch is read-only: it cannot set timers or background commands
prompt-schedule.error.sidecarTools: An ask-only side branch is read-only: it cannot use the timer and background tools
prompt-schedule.error.timers: At most {n, plural, one {# timer} other {# timers}} at a time: cancel the ones you no longer need first
prompt-schedule.error.wakeupNoCron: A one-time timer has no cron / end time
prompt-schedule.event.noRerun: Not re-run automatically (to avoid repeating side effects); if needed, check the state and start it again.
prompt-schedule.event.restartLost: [{product} {what} interrupted] {label} · the Runner restarted, the process has ended
prompt-schedule.every.uneven: Pick an interval of minutes that divides an hour evenly, hours that divide a day evenly, or once a day; for any other interval use cron
prompt-schedule.fire.last: · this is the last run (end time reached)
prompt-schedule.fire.late: (late: the node or the control plane was not available then)
prompt-schedule.held.check: If needed, check the latest state of these items yourself.
prompt-schedule.held.dropped: {n} more were dropped because they exceeded the limit of {max}
prompt-schedule.held.droppedLabel: Results over the limit while paused
prompt-schedule.held.head: [{product}: results from while paused]
prompt-schedule.held.stale: {n, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} from while it was paused expired (older than 7 days) and are not delivered one by one
prompt-schedule.reason.budget: the daily limit of self-started turns was reached
prompt-schedule.reason.full: the session's message queue was full
prompt-schedule.reason.throttle: the monitor's wake-up interval had not passed yet
prompt-schedule.redeliver.taken: (these reports were already delivered in an earlier turn; nothing new to handle)
prompt-schedule.residentPaused: The resident Agent is paused: click "Resume" in Settings on the web page or in a current App, then send again
prompt-schedule.template.time: Write the time as HH:MM (the server's time zone), for example 09:00
